name: Connecticut
about: The blueprint of Connecticut (perfectnations.com/perfect-states/connecticut/). Census, NAEP and USDA figures marked "computed" are read by tools/build_us_state.py from data/us/raw/connecticut/ and data/us-states.json. Since 2022 the Census Bureau reports Connecticut by nine planning regions in place of its eight former counties; the map follows the Census. No figure is estimated.
notes: v1.0: Perfect Connecticut, a Perfect States blueprint (Preeti Sinha, President and CEO, 25 Nov 2026: "go ahead and implement" the Perfect States plan). Water and Energy are shown as not yet measured: no primary state figure was confirmed.

solutions.title: Solutions for Perfect Connecticut, in order.
solutions.line: Shelter first: homelessness has risen while every other standard holds.

items.challenge: 3,735 people had no home on one night in January 2025, up 23.1% since 2019.
items.advises: Take the Green Bank model to housing: a State housing fund that uses public dollars to draw private capital into supportive homes, repaid in part as households move from shelter into homes of their own.

items.challenge: 12.4% of people in Greater Bridgeport live below the poverty line, the highest of the nine planning regions (2020–2024).
items.advises: Pair CT Baby Bonds with an outcome contract for jobs in Greater Bridgeport, so the first cohort meets a stronger local economy when it turns 18 in 2041.

items.challenge: computed:food of households were food insecure in 2022–2024.
items.advises: Use the State’s $500m reserve for federal actions as first-loss capital in a food-security fund, so lenders and food banks keep households supplied as SNAP rules change.

solutions.hold: Phase 3, hold the line: health coverage (computed:uninsured uninsured) and reading (computed:reading at the NAEP Proficient level), with water and energy measured next.

intelligence.title: An $80m SNAP bill that accuracy can cut.
intelligence.line: From October 2027 every state pays part of its SNAP food benefits unless at least 94 of every 100 dollars are paid exactly right. AI that checks every case before it is paid can shrink that bill.
intelligence.bill_label: a year in SNAP benefits from October 2027, at the 2025 error rate

facts.label: of SNAP dollars paid in error, 2025
share of benefits the State pays from October 2027

intelligence.advises: Bring the error rate under 8% and the share halves to 5%, about $40m a year saved. Fund AI case review from the savings, starting with the fiscal 2027 rate that sets the bill for fiscal 2030, and audit it every quarter for underpayments as well as overpayments.
